comment: Timed voiceover script for CrimePsych (30s @ 30fps). `start` is a target aligned to the scene timeline; the generator places lines sequentially (never overlapping), so these act as minimum start times. Kept lean (~26s of speech) so a natural read fits 30s.

voice.recommended: calm, measured, low-timbre true-crime narrator; unhurried; pause before reveals

lines.text: The psychology of crime and horror.
Morbid curiosity isn't a flaw. It's an adaptation.
Your brain, rehearsing danger from safety.
Fear turns to thrill through a paradox.
The alarm fires, then you're safe, and dread becomes a high.
The core audience? Women. Learning to survive.
Suspense over surprise. Sound over image.
Open a loop, then close it.
And above all: center the victim, not the killer.
